about_the_game:
Camera Movement Plugin is an RPG Maker official plugin that lets you move the camera

with fine-grained controls.

 

You can move to specified X/Y coordinates or to coordinates stored in variables.

You can even move the camera to center on an event on the map (by providing its ID).

 

RPG Maker official Camera Movement Plugin gives you access to 4 Plugin Commands:

 

● Scroll to Fixed Location: Specify the X and Y coordinates you wish to center the camera on.

● Scroll to Variable Location: Specify the variables that store the X and Y coordinates you wish to center the camera on.

● Scroll to Event: Specify the Event ID you wish to center the camera on

● Reset Camera: Scroll the camera back to the main character

 

For each of these plugin commands you will be able to select the scrolling speed. You can

even select a "Custom" speed allowing you to type a duration instead (in number of frames).

 

Finally, for each of these plugin commands you can choose whether you want to wait for completion or not.

 

Note that if you don't wait for completion and have multiple camera movements chained one after the other, only the last one will be taken into account.

--------------------------

・This pack is for use in RPG Maker Series or the engine of your choice.

・OK to be used in Commercial projects made in RPG Maker

・You may modify some of the assets (but not redistribute them) for your own game use only.
